contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #258: Gersten’s conjecture and virtual compact specialness of one-relator groups.

Resolve row:restriction for every subgroup U of the height kernel L, every actual level, and the coarse-row and incident-slot versions, preserving both primitive presentations and right group-ring multiplication on left coefficient chains.

definitions.faithful_coefficient_module: A right QK-module M with an injective additive, right QK-linear map into a division ring containing QK; M need not be a ring or contain inverses.
definitions.primitive_forms: pr(x,y) or pr(xy,z), with B0 common free alphabet, both extreme letters essential, nonzero primitive quotient exponents d,n, and the actual Bass-Serre stabilizers.

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 258 (Gersten’s conjecture and virtual compact specialness of one-relator groups.; papers: Baumslag-Solitar-free one-relator groups are hyperbolic; Virtual compact specialness of hyperbolic one-relator groups; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For all U<=L and every actual refined or coarse level, the direct sum over actual U-orbits of H1(U intersect X_xi;D_U) maps injectively to H1(U;D_U); the analogous sum over one incident slot in a refined or coarse vertex row injects. The proof holds over the induced modules before overfield extension.

For either primitive presentation, every map from a refined edge group to either adjacent vertex group induces an H1 monomorphism over every faithful coefficient module, with no division inside that module.

In a line of abelian groups with injective maps at both ends of each edge, a finitely supported edge family whose incidence boundary is supported at one vertex is zero. Consequently each vertex summand embeds in the incidence cokernel.

For M=D_U tensor_(QU) QK, Mackey-Shapiro identifies H1(X;M) with the direct sum over U backslash K / X of H1(U intersect gXg^-1;D_U), and the map to H1(K;M)=H1(U;D_U) is the transported sum of subgroup inclusions with actual conjugating frames.

The original primitive presentations give the displayed free and root-extension rows and an unfolded line; their Fox chain maps have the triangular, power, and private-column forms needed by the division-free edge and line arguments.

claims.natural_statement: For arbitrary integer-indexed abelian edge and vertex groups with injective endpoint maps, a finite-support incidence relation supported at one vertex is zero. In any division ring, right nonzero pivots, triangular free-chain maps, private relation columns, and the two root-row Fox frame changes satisfy the universal assertions declared in Main.lean.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace RowRestriction

section Pivots

variable {D : Type*} [DivisionRing D]

theorem right_pivot_cancel {c p : D} (hp : p ≠ 0) (h : c * p = 0) :
    c = 0 :=
  (mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_right hp

theorem triangular_injective {B : Type*} (q : B → D) (p : D) (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun v : (B → D) × D => ((fun j => v.1 j + v.2 * q j), v.2 * p)) := by
  intro v w h
  have hpivot : v.2 * p = w.2 * p := congrArg Prod.snd h
  have hdiff : (v.2 - w.2) * p = 0 := by
    rw [sub_mul, hpivot, sub_self]
  have hc : v.2 = w.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp (right_pivot_cancel hp hdiff)
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext j
    have hj := congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst h) j
    change v.1 j + v.2 * q j = w.1 j + w.2 * q j at hj
    rw [hc] at hj
    exact add_right_cancel hj
  · exact hc

theorem private_column
    {A B W : Type*} [AddGroup A] [AddGroup B] [AddGroup W]
    (source : A →+ W) (relation : B →+ W)
    (probe : W →+ D) (coefficient : B →+ D)
    (hs : Function.Injective source) (hc : Function.Injective coefficient)
    (p : D) (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (hsource : ∀ a, probe (source a) = 0)
    (hrelation : ∀ b, probe (relation b) = coefficient b * p)
    {a : A} {b : B} (h : source a = relation b) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
  have hzero : coefficient b * p = 0 := by
    rw [← hrelation b, ← h, hsource a]
  have hb : b = 0 := hc (by simpa using right_pivot_cancel hp hzero)
  have ha : a = 0 := hs (by simpa [hb] using h)
  exact ⟨ha, hb⟩

def xToY (x s : D) (v : D × D) : D × D :=
  (-v.1 * x, v.1 * s + v.2)

def yToX (x s : D) (v : D × D) : D × D :=
  (-v.1 * x⁻¹, v.1 * x⁻¹ * s + v.2)

theorem root_frame_inverse (x s : D) (hx : x ≠ 0) (v : D × D) :
    yToX x s (xToY x s v) = v ∧ xToY x s (yToX x s v) = v := by
  constructor <;> apply Prod.ext <;>
    simp [xToY, yToX, mul_assoc, hx]

end Pivots

section Line

variable {E V : ℤ → Type*}
variable [∀ i, AddCommGroup (E i)] [∀ i, AddCommGroup (V i)]

theorem line_single_support
    (left : ∀ i, E i →+ V i) (right : ∀ i, E (i - 1) →+ V i)
    (hl : ∀ i, Function.Injective (left i))
    (hr : ∀ i, Function.Injective (right i))
    (b : ∀ i, E i) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (hs : ∀ i, b i ≠ 0 ↔ i ∈ s) (root : ℤ)
    (hboundary : ∀ i, i ≠ root → left i (b i) = right i (b (i - 1))) :
    ∀ i, b i = 0 := by
  classical
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := not_forall.mp h
  have hne : s.Nonempty := ⟨j, (hs j).mp hj⟩
  let lo := s.min' hne
  let hi := s.max' hne
  have hlo : lo ∈ s := Finset.min'_mem s hne
  have hhi : hi ∈ s := Finset.max'_mem s hne
  have hbelow : b (lo - 1) = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hm : lo - 1 ∈ s := (hs (lo - 1)).mp hn
    have hh : lo ≤ lo - 1 := Finset.min'_le s (lo - 1) hm
    omega
  have habove : b (hi + 1) = 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    have hm : hi + 1 ∈ s := (hs (hi + 1)).mp hn
    have hh : hi + 1 ≤ hi := Finset.le_max' s (hi + 1) hm
    omega
  have hroot : lo = root := by
    by_contra hn
    have he := hboundary lo hn
    have hz : b lo = 0 := hl lo (by simpa [hbelow] using he)
    exact ((hs lo).mpr hlo) hz
  have horder : lo ≤ hi := Finset.min'_le s hi hhi
  have hfar : hi + 1 ≠ root := by omega
  have he := hboundary (hi + 1) hfar
  have hz : b ((hi + 1) - 1) = 0 :=
    hr (hi + 1) (by simpa [habove] using he.symm)
  have hn : b ((hi + 1) - 1) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using ((hs hi).mpr hhi)
  exact hn hz

theorem line_vertex_relation
    (left : ∀ i, E i →+ V i) (right : ∀ i, E (i - 1) →+ V i)
    (hl : ∀ i, Function.Injective (left i))
    (hr : ∀ i, Function.Injective (right i))
    (b : ∀ i, E i) (s : Finset ℤ)
    (hs : ∀ i, b i ≠ 0 ↔ i ∈ s) (root : ℤ) (v : V root)
    (hboundary : ∀ i, i ≠ root → left i (b i) = right i (b (i - 1)))
    (hatroot : left root (b root) - right root (b (root - 1)) = v) :
    v = 0 := by
  have hz := line_single_support left right hl hr b s hs root hboundary
  simpa [hz root, hz (root - 1)] using hatroot.symm

end Line

end RowRestriction

routes.retired_because: Overfield-only homology or quotient injectivity does not imply saturation over an induced coefficient module: Q[s,s^-1]/(s-1) is nonzero but becomes zero over Q(s). This rejects a proof inference, not the original row proposition.
